description: Ask a person for files, through Files Direct. It opens a room that asks and returns a link and a nine-digit code at once; give them to the person (for example: "send me the signed PDF"). They open it, see that they are being asked and by what kind of device, read your note, and choose the files. The files go straight to this computer, are checked, and are saved in the background into an allowed folder. Nothing is stored on our servers, so the room only works while this server is running. Your asking is the yes: nothing is replaced, and an offer over the size or file limit is refused. It ends after the first batch is saved. Follow it with transfer_status: it lists the names, sizes and saved paths of what arrived.

folder.description: Where to save, inside an allowed folder. It is made if it is not there. Default: a folder called files-direct-received in the first allowed folder.

max_files.description: Refuse an offer with more files than this. Default 1000.

max_size_mb.description: Refuse an offer bigger than this many megabytes. Default 2048.

note.description: What you need, for the person to read, for example "the signed lease". Shown only to them, cut to 200 characters, and never sent to our servers.

password.description: A password the other person has to type before they can join. Tell it to them another way than the link.

name: ask_for_files
title: Ask someone for files
